capabilities_done: (1) score wave_edit::WaveBuffer (src/wave_edit.rs): sample-accurate cut / copy / paste (insert, overwrite, mix per channel mask) / delete / silence / insert silence, fades with score FadeCurve shapes (fade out = mirrored fade in, exact 0 at the end), gain envelope (linear in dB, held outside points), amplify, peak normalise (linked or per channel; silent channel None), invert, reverse, zero-crossing snap (nearest/earlier/later, all masked channels, file edges count) and snap_selection inward/outward, process_channels (atomic); every refusal leaves the buffer bit-equal; growth bounded by MAX_WAVE_FRAMES with fallible reserve; cancel between scan chunks

(1) harness view::waveform: non-destructive edit list (schema hsk.studio.waveform_edit@1: source identity + ops, no samples) in the session entry waveform_edit (new session token), each audio edit ONE entry-only history step (Run::set_tiles_and_entry), replayed after undo/redo/save+reopen; paste stores a reference to the copied prefix + digest (stale clipboard refused); hostile entry bytes bounded (4 MiB, 4096 ops), typed, unknown ops refused, source mismatch refused; selection with optional zero-crossing snap; egui panel waveform.* (canvas min/max per column, drag select, all ops, undo/redo)

(2) score Spectrogram::with_window (Hann / Hamming / Blackman / Blackman-Harris / rectangular, calibrated, Hann bit-identical) + spectral_view (linear/log frequency rows in dB, row<->Hz maps, tiles of 64 frames in a byte-bounded LRU cache with stats); harness view::spectral_display (per-channel caches invalidated by the edit list digest, columns, RGBA image, panel spectral.* with window/scale/FFT controls)

(3) score spectral_mask_edit: marquee or even-odd lasso region over (sample, Hz) cells; identity / attenuate / remove / heal (per-bin log-magnitude interpolation across each selected run from frames 3 hops outside, phase kept); inverse STFT weighted overlap-add over the affected samples only, outside bit-exact; identity reconstruction error <= 1e-6 for all 5 windows; bounds before allocation; harness WaveformEdit::Spectral (one undo step, replayed) + marquee/lasso selection and remove/attenuate/heal on the spectral display

(4) harness WaveformEdit::Effect: a stored Folio effect instance (gain / equalizer / dynamics / lookahead limiter via EffectSpec; keyframes refused) over a 1-2 channel selection through a latency-compensated score Chain bounce, one undo step, replayed

spec_basis: Module 14 has no STU-AUD clauses (grep of 14-studio-creative-suite.md v02.216 for STU-AUD: no match; no waveform-editor, zero-crossing, spectral-display or lasso clause for audio). Parity rows AU-12 / AU-19 / AU-20 of research/parity-matrix-20261016.json cite 'vendor' for AU-12/AU-20.

[STU-FX-135] 'An audio processor applied to a clip or a track is an ordered entry ... re-editable ... removable with exact restoration of the prior result ... There is no "render audio to apply" step.' -> the waveform editor never rewrites source samples; it stores an edit list replayed over the source, and undo restores the prior list exactly.

[STU-FX-134a] processor set includes 'Amplify' (dva_audio, 4 params, AudioFilter:Amplify) -> amplify / normalise operate on selections; parameter mapping of the Amplify row is not declared in the spec (no parity claimed).

[STU-ARC-013] 'committed edits, exports and recording MUST NOT silently drop. Stop/deadline/cancel epochs MUST be observed between bounded compute chunks.' -> refusals change nothing, cancel checks between chunks / frames.

[STU-AUT-020] 'The approved scope now includes explicitly supported native CLAP/VST3 provider adapters under [HSK-PLG-002], [HSK-PLG-010] and [HSK-PLG-017] ... Unsupported plugins remain disclosed, preserved where safe and unavailable; no unsandboxed fallback' (module 05: HSK-PLG-010 'Native discovery ... Separate bounded isolated discovery from activation'; HSK-PLG-017 'automated invocation MUST NOT raise vendor windows').
